summary: Frontend-only testing of Pipeline page redesign completed successfully. All 12 features tested and working correctly including accordion-based layout, group funnel filtering, contextual status text, navigation, filters, and mobile responsiveness.
passed_tests: Pipeline page loads correctly with all 4 groups (Action Required, Upcoming, In Progress, Closed)
Group funnel at the top shows correct counts (All 14, Action Required 4, Upcoming 2, In Progress 5, Closed 3)
Group funnel clicking filters groups - only selected group visible when clicked
Clicking 'All' resets filter and shows all 4 groups
Accordion toggle (expand/collapse) works for each group
Closed group is collapsed by default (chevron not rotated)
Program cards show university name, division badge (D1/D2/D3), match score (71%/93%/44%), region, conference, coach info
Contextual status text shows on right side - 'Overdue since Feb 10', 'Not contacted yet', 'Due Feb 24', 'Active conversation', 'Recently contacted'
Journey button on each card navigates to /journey/{id}
Search filter works - searching 'Florida' showed 1 card
Division dropdown filter works - selecting D1 showed 6 cards
Region dropdown filter works - selecting Midwest showed 4 cards
Mobile responsiveness (390px) - page renders correctly with all components visible
test_credentials: No credentials needed - public app with mocked auth (get_current_user MOCKED)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pipeline page redesign verified. Key data-testid attributes: recruiting-board, group-funnel, funnel-all, funnel-action_required/upcoming/in_progress/closed, section-{group}, toggle-{group}, program-row-{id}, program-link-{id}, view-journey-{id}, match-score-{id}, board-search, filter-division, filter-region, add-school-btn. Accordion headers include inline descriptions. Contextual status text hidden on mobile (sm:block class). Tour modal appears on first load - dismiss with 'Skip tour' button.
console_warnings_noted: React hydration warning on ProgramDetail page: <span> cannot be child of <option> - This is in ProgramDetail.js not Pipeline, related to FieldSelect component structure

features_verified.connected_panels: Header + cards render as one visual unit with rounded-t-[10px] header and rounded-b-[10px] cards container
features_verified.compact_cards: Row-based layout with py-2.5 lg:py-3 padding
features_verified.colored_accent_bars: 3px width accent bars: rose-500 for Action Required, amber-500 for Upcoming, emerald-500 for In Progress, gray-500 for Closed
features_verified.accordion_headers: Include inline descriptions like 'Overdue, needs response, or stale'
